EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
Land Ministry Ref. No.: 4-3/8/2011/PC119. My Reference No.: WAR/AN/ACQUS/A2/5-32.

I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as Amended by the land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose:
Description of the Land to be acquired:

Lot No. 1-23 (Lots 23) allotments in extent of about 0.0682 Hectare of land in Preliminary Plan No. Ke. 3473 and dated 15.07.2014, prepared by the Senior Superintendent of Surveys of Kegalle on behalf of the Surveyor General situated in the village of Kahagalla in the Grama Niladhari Division of 86 A Ihala Lengala in the Minor Division of Beligal Korale North in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Warakapola in Kegalle District in Sabaragamuwa Province.
